title: Unified rendering & asset sanitization pipeline for onboarding screenshots and docs
creator: Amelia Chen
description: Goal: build a single, deterministic pipeline that produces brand-consistent, localization-safe, and privacy-redacted UI screenshots and accompanying assets for onboarding flows, quickstarts, and docs. The pipeline should support manual export from Figma, automated rendering from storybook/GH workflows, deterministic cropping/spacing rules, user-data redaction heuristics, multi-locale overlays, and a lightweight QA step. Outputs: primary screenshot (3 sizes: hero, card, thumbnail), annotated variant (with copy hooks), and a compact metadata file for the Console and docs site describing locale, route, component, and cropping box. This ticket covers the design spec, crop presets, redaction patterns, localization overlay guidance, QA checklist, and handed-off asset export templates for engineering to implement the automation worker and for Content to consume.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec document with crop presets for hero/card/thumbnail completed and approved by Product
Redaction rulebook (PII patterns + visual masks) documented and validated against three sample screens from onboarding flows
Localization-safe overlays for RTL and long-string locales specified; whitespace-safe crop rules verified for es, de, ja
Export template (Figma + Storybook snapshot instructions) uploaded and linked in PRD
A sample pipeline run producing 9 assets (3 sizes x 3 locales) plus metadata file and passing QA checklist
Hand-off package (Figma page, export checklist, sample metadata JSON schema) accepted by ENG-owners ENG-2893 and ENG-3012
decisions: Use soft redaction (blur + synthetic placeholder text) for email/username fields to preserve composition while protecting data
Crop anchors will be component-centric rather than viewport-centric to avoid cutting off CTA/labels during localization
RTL support will be implemented via mirrored crop presets and pre-defined padding rules instead of per-locale manual adjustments
Metadata will be a small JSON file (route, locale, crop_box, asset_variant) so Console can programmatically choose appropriate image
open_questions: Should we include a branded watermark for public assets? Trade-off between brand and reuse by partners needs PM guidance
What level of automated OCR detection do we require vs. privacy-safe heuristics (e.g., detect @, email pattern, credit card masks)?
Do we allow developer-supplied flags in PRD to opt-out of redaction for certain internal screenshots?
Who signs off on non-English layout regressions: Design or Content? Define SLA for fixes.
